text: Mathematics and Applied Mathematics (Teacher Training) is a national first-class undergraduate major construction point, a key major in Zhejiang Province, a characteristic major in the "13th Five-Year Plan" of Zhejiang Province, and a provincial first-class undergraduate major construction point. This major won the 2018 and 2020 Most Employable Competitiveness Professional Comprehensive Award of Wenzhou University, and the 2020 Most Career Development Competitiveness Professional Comprehensive Award. To cultivate outstanding primary and secondary school teachers who master the basic theories and methods of mathematical sciences, have the ability to use mathematical knowledge and use computers to solve practical problems, have solid basic knowledge of mathematics and mathematics education, and have a high degree of specialization in teachers. Graduates can engage in teaching, research and research in education, science and technology, economics and other departments, or engage in practical application, development, research and management in production, operation and management departments. Main courses: mathematical analysis, advanced algebra, spatial analytic geometry, recent algebra, ordinary differential equations, probability theory and mathematical statistics, complex functions, real-variant functions, differential geometry, pedagogy, psychology, secondary mathematics teaching theory, elementary mathematics research, competition mathematics, modern educational technology applications, etc.
